decision_conditions: There is not an identified need within the borough for new supported living provisions and the site does not have access to essential services and shops by walking and is also not well served by public transport. Accordingly, the proposed change of use is unacceptable in principle and contrary to Policy 6(i), (ii) and (iii) of the Local Plan.

The proposed change of use, by virtue of its scale including proposed occupancy/levels of staffing, would result in undue harm to the residential amenity of neighbouring occupiers through noise, disturbance and general activity arising from comings and goings and the turnover of staff and residents in a manner distinguishable from the use of the property as a single dwelling house. The proposal would therefore be contrary to Policies 6(viii), 7 and 34 of the Local Plan, Policy H12 of the London Plan as well as the objectives of the NPPF.

Statement Required by Article 35 (2) of the Town and Country Planning (Development Management Procedure) (England) Order 2015: Consideration was given to seeking amendments, but given conflict with adopted planning policy, notification of intended refusal and the reasons for it was given to the agent in writing on 11/03/2026.
description: Change of use from Class C3(a) (residential) to C3(b) (supported living) and retention of as built rear extension.
